cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Medical Laboratory Technician I is part of the provider care team who helps with diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patient conditions through the use of technical and scientific knowledge. This position is responsible for accurate, precise, and timely performance of laboratory tests. The Medical Laboratory Technician I evaluates and reports test results while assuring compliance and meeting all regulatory requirements consistent with the quality of a [Company name masked] Laboratory. The Medical Laboratory Technician I will be required to exhibit excellent customer service skills in all internal and external customer interactions.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent with documentation of training appropriate for the testing performed prior to analyzing patient specimens.
1-Year acceptable clinical laboratory experience.
MLT (ASCP) or equivalent certification.
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree in chemistry, biology, or other science-related field that meets certification agency requirements.
High school graduate or equivalent who has successfully completed an official military medical laboratory procedures course of at least 50 weeks duration and held the military enlisted occupational specialty of Medical Laboratory Specialist (Laboratory Technician).

We are looking for a Medical Lab Technician I to join our team.
The Medical Laboratory Technician I is part of the provider care team who helps with diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patient conditions through the use of technical and scientific knowledge. cond_0114.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Medical Laboratory Technician I is part of the provider care team who helps with diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patient conditions through the use of technical and scientific knowledge. This position is responsible for accurate, precise, and timely performance of laboratory tests. The Medical Laboratory Technician I evaluates and reports test results while assuring compliance and meeting all regulatory requirements consistent with the quality of a [Company name masked] Laboratory. A large part of the role involves regular interaction with internal and external customers, and the Medical Laboratory Technician I is expected to communicate clearly and handle questions with confidence in all of those interactions.
cond_0114.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent with documentation of training appropriate for the testing performed prior to analyzing patient specimens.
MLT (ASCP) or equivalent certification.
1 Year of acceptable clinical laboratory experience.
Preferred Requirements
High school graduate or equivalent who has successfully completed an official military medical laboratory procedures course of at least 50 weeks and held the military enlisted occupational specialty of Medical Laboratory Specialist (Laboratory Technician).
Associate's degree in chemistry, biology, or other science-related field that meets certification agency requirements.

The Medical Laboratory Technician I evaluates and reports test results while assuring compliance and meeting all regulatory requirements consistent with the quality of a [Company name masked] Laboratory. The Medical Laboratory Technician I will be required to work with excellent customer service skills in all internal and external customer interactions.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent with documentation of training appropriate for the testing performed prior to analyzing patient specimens.
1 Year of acceptable clinical laboratory experience.
MLT (ASCP) or equivalent certification.
Preferred Requirements
Successfully completed an official military medical laboratory procedures course of at least 50 weeks and held the military enlisted occupational specialty of Medical Laboratory Specialist (Laboratory Technician).
Associate's degree in chemistry, biology, or other science-related field that meets certification agency requirements.

cond_0331.intro: The Medical Laboratory Technician I is part of the provider care team who helps with diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patient conditions through the use of technical and scientific knowledge. This position is responsible for accurate, precise, and timely performance of laboratory tests. The Medical Laboratory Technician I evaluates and reports test results while assuring compliance and meeting all regulatory requirements consistent with laboratory quality standards. The Medical Laboratory Technician I will be required to exhibit strong customer service skills in all internal and external customer interactions.
cond_0331.requirements:

High school diploma or equivalent with documentation of training appropriate for the testing performed prior to analyzing patient specimens.
MLT (ASCP) or equivalent certification.
1 Year of acceptable clinical laboratory experience.
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree in chemistry, biology, or other science-related field that meets certification agency requirements.
High school diploma or equivalent plus successful completion of an official military medical laboratory procedures course of at least 50 weeks duration, with the military enlisted occupational specialty of Medical Laboratory Specialist (Laboratory Technician).

The Medical Laboratory Technician I evaluates and reports test results while assuring compliance and meeting all regulatory requirements consistent with the quality of a [Company name masked] Laboratory. The Medical Laboratory Technician I will be required to exhibit excellent customer service skills in all internal and external customer interactions.
cond_0602.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent with documentation of training appropriate for the testing performed prior to analyzing patient specimens.
1 Year of acceptable clinical laboratory experience.
MLT (ASCP) or equivalent certification.
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree in chemistry, biology, or other science-related field that meets certification agency requirements.
High school graduate or equivalent who has successfully completed an official military medical laboratory procedures course of at least 50 weeks and held the military enlisted occupational specialty of Medical Laboratory Specialist (Laboratory Technician).
cond_0602.inclusion: We actively seek women candidates with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. The Medical Laboratory Technician I is part of the provider care team who helps with diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patient conditions through the use of technical and scientific knowledge. This position is responsible for accurate, precise, and timely performance of laboratory tests. The Medical Laboratory Technician I evaluates and reports test results while assuring compliance and meeting all regulatory requirements consistent with the quality of a [Company name masked] Laboratory. The Medical Laboratory Technician I will be required to exhibit excellent customer service skills in all internal and external customer interactions. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with laboratory testing and patient care workflows.
cond_0626.requirements:
Be a high school graduate or equivalent and have successfully completed an official military medical laboratory procedures course of at least 50 weeks duration and have held the military enlisted occupational specialty of Medical Laboratory Specialist (Laboratory Technician).
Have earned a high school diploma or equivalent and have documentation of training appropriate for the testing performed prior to analyzing patient specimens.
1-Year acceptable clinical laboratory experience.
Associate's degree in chemistry, biology or other science related field that meets requirements for certification agency requirements.
MLT (ASCP) or equivalent.
cond_0626.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
